name: HAMQTT
description: Lightweight Home Assistant MQTT Auto-Discovery with smart caching. Features Device Groups for organizing entities into sub-devices, and Read-Only entities for display purposes. Optimized for ESP8266 memory constraints. Supports sensors, binary sensors, buttons, switches, selects, and numbers.
keywords: mqtt, home-assistant, homeassistant, autodiscovery, esp8266, esp32, iot, arduino, cache, lightweight, memory-optimized, groups, device-groups, read-only, sub-devices
